about.title: About the Paldean Fates set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Paldean Fates is a Scarlet & Violet expansion released on 26 January 2024. It has 245 cards: 91 in the main set and 154 secret rares. For a master set there are also 81 reverse holos, and 7 special prints from other products and events.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 91 main set cards), the Complete set (all 245 cards), the Master set (326 cards, adding every reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (333 cards, adding the 7 special prints (stamped, Cosmos Holo and other product-exclusive cards)).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
